verdict.rationale: Unit documents APIs for accounts, real-time balances and payments, and configurable card controls. Nothing in the pack shows scoped credentials for an agent, transfer amount caps, counterparty allowlists, or any vendor-named agent account-operation use case. Card controls are an adjacent feature and general API access is a developer building block, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate an account within policy — scoped credentials that let it read balances and initiate transfers under amount caps and counterparty allowlists, a use the vendor documents by name
